scripts.build: node build_node.js && cp index.html compiled/ && cp index.css compiled/ && (cp robots.txt compiled/ || true) && (cp sitemap.xml compiled/ || true) && sed -i 's|/index.tsx|/index.js|g' compiled/index.html && for lang in en pt jp de zh ar; do mkdir -p compiled/$lang && cp compiled/index.html compiled/$lang/ && mkdir -p $lang && cp compiled/index.html $lang/; done && cp compiled/index.html compiled/404.html && cp compiled/index.js ./index.js && cp compiled/404.html ./404.html
